page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-192-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is equipped with 1512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory allocation of approximately 7.88 GB per core.

This instance configuration does not include any graphics processing units. For storage, the server is classified as a storage-optimized virtual machine featuring twenty-four local NVMe SSDs, though specific capacity metrics for these local drives are not defined in the hardware profile.

Given the high density of both dedicated processing cores and memory capacity, this server type represents a high-resource tier within the z4d family. It is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints and local NVMe storage, such as large-scale databases, data warehousing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
